plan.amendment_reason: Automated absolute monotonic scheduling; fresh IDs; v1 and v1.1 retained as pilot/methodology evidence only.

pilot_v1_handling.classification: methodology pilot only; excluded from final A/B/C/D controlled comparison

plan.sender_rule: same existing experimental DID for all four probes

schedule.rule: Dispatch at absolute monotonic offsets 0,180,360,540 seconds from first dispatch anchor. Venue times measured, never promised exact. Windows inclusive [posted.ts, posted.ts+120s], later seq only.

plan.primary_outcome: At least one attributable response from another DID within 120 seconds.
attribution_rules: response contains the unique probe/task ID
response contains the requested exact ACK token
protocol response explicitly references the probe/task ID
otherwise unambiguous direct reference; flag for manual review

execution.abort_policy: Any read failure, seq gap/reset, timing violation, uncertain POST or duplicate ID aborts remaining writes. No retries or resume. A successful block has exactly four POST attempts; safety aborts can have fewer.
execution.gate_clock: UTC read completion; five minutes lookback, ten seconds future tolerance; ambient count includes self, distinct DID count excludes self, matching original script.
execution.signing: Pre-signed public bundle only; no secret input or identity creation.
execution.capture: Cursor polling limit=200 every 2 seconds; validate contiguous seq and never advance beyond received records.
execution.attribution: ID token matches automatic; all other messages retained for manual direct-reference review; claimed DID and signature verification distinguished.
